items.title: Inkling 2 Mini is a looped transformer that runs on a laptop. Looping lets a model think more and w…
items.text: Inkling 2 Mini is a looped transformer that runs on a laptop. Looping lets a model think more and write less. At this scale, its thought process remains monitorable; this may not stay the case. We’re also sharing a variable-loop research model to enable further study.
items.story: TML releases Inkling 2 Mini, an open-weights 26.4B-parameter transformer that loops middle layers three times per token for better reasoning with fewer tokens

items.text: We've been working on understanding model capabilities beyond what our prior time horizon tasks could capture. Today we’re sharing a research update. We find that AI R&D-relevant capabilities are improving rapidly and are getting harder to measure.
